title: Pair Encoding of an Appended String
statement: Let $C,c$ be natural numbers and let $x,u$ be Boolean strings such that $|u|=C(|x|+1)^c$. Then splitting the concatenation $x\mathbin{+}u$ by the polynomial padding rule yields the pair encoding of $x$ and $u$: the bits of $x$ are doubled, followed by the separator $01$ and then $u$.
